checks.reason: For A_i=e_i^T, sum A_i^*A_i=sum e_i e_i^T=I_n, hence Tr V_in^2=n. The one-sided constant for p=4 is sqrt(p-1) raised to p, i.e. 9, so the asserted one-input bound is 9n.
